name: Fortune
identity: Mark a face with Boon, risk rerolls for Streak, and spend Insurance to keep progress after a miss. Favor offers a small, reliable number change.
loop: Mark Boon faces → risk rerolls to grow Streak and earn Favor → spend Insurance to protect a missed attempt → cash in three Streak for Jackpot or use Favor for a small number change.
statuses: When you physically roll a face marked with your Boon, gain 1 Favor. Earn this no more than twice per round. During Offensive, spend 2 Favor to change one of your combat dice by +1 or −1, staying within 1–6. Use this once per round. Changing a number does not count as rolling a Boon. Keep unused Favor. You cannot change a Frostbound die.
Positive die-face mark · your combat dice · max 2 marked faces

Mark one face on one of your combat dice. Rolling that face earns Favor, even when you roll that die for a status or another effect. Changing a die to that face does not earn Favor. Erase the Boon after it is rolled twice, or after your next Offensive segment ends. Boon and Curse can share a face and both work when it is rolled.

Whenever you choose to reroll combat dice during Offensive, gain 1 Streak if at least one of those dice lands on Boon. Otherwise lose 1 Streak. Count the whole reroll attempt once, not each die. During Offensive, spend 3 Streak for Jackpot: gain 1 Energy and draw 2 cards. Use Jackpot once per round. Keep unused Streak.

When one of your voluntary Offensive rerolls misses every Boon, you may spend 1 Insurance to keep the Streak you would have lost. It does not give Favor or turn the miss into a hit. Keep unused Insurance.
abilities: Apply one Boon if a slot exists; gain 1 Insurance.
Deal 5 damage. Optionally spend 1 Favor when choosing this ability to gain 1 Streak afterward.
Deal 6 damage; apply one Boon if a slot exists and gain 1 Favor.
Each Pip prevents 1; each Coin gains 1 Favor; any Star gains 1 Insurance.
Pip: prevent 2. Coin: prevent 3. Star: prevent 2 and apply one Boon if a slot exists.
cards: Apply one Boon to a chosen face on one of your combat dice if a slot exists.
Apply one Boon to a face that already has Curse, or apply an ordinary Boon if none of your faces have Curse.
Spend 1 Favor; roll one of your combat dice to determine this card’s result. On 1–3 gain 1 Insurance; on 4–6 gain 1 Streak.
Spend up to 2 Favor; add 2 damage each to your attack.
Spend 2 Favor; gain 1 Energy. Once per round.
Spend 2 Streak; draw 2 and gain 1 Insurance. Does not count as Jackpot.
Move one of your Boon marks to an unmarked face of the same die, preserving remaining hits and expiry.
Shift the number on one of your combat dice that is not Frostbound by 1 without going below 1 or above 6. Your final dice must still allow the ability you choose. Boon does not trigger.
Spend 1 Favor; physically reroll one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card once. Curse or Boon can activate if the die rolls a marked face.
Spend 1 Favor; set one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card to face 3. Changing a number does not activate Boon or Curse.
Prevent 2 from one attack, card or status targeting you.
Spend 1 Insurance to prevent 2 damage from one attack, card or status. That Insurance cannot also protect your Streak. This gives no Favor.
Spend 1 Favor; stop 1 negative status stack an enemy is about to apply to you.
Remove one of your Boon marks; gain 1 Favor. Its remaining potential is lost.
After your first combat roll, set one of your combat dice that is not Frostbound to face 4. No Streak or Favor trigger.
Spend 1 Streak; prevent 3 from one incoming attack.
Upgrade once per battle: the first physical Boon hit each round grants 2 Favor instead of 1; still uses one of two reward slots.
Spend 2 Favor; gain 2 Streak and 1 Insurance. Normal caps apply; no automatic Jackpot.
Spend 3 Favor; prevent 4 and gain 1 Insurance after the damage is dealt.
pairs: Boon and Curse can share a die face. A real roll of that face activates both. Insurance can protect Streak when a reroll misses Boon, but cannot stop Curse when its marked face is rolled.
Voluntary combat rerolls earn Charge while giving Boon and Streak a chance to work. Insurance can protect a missed Streak without losing that reroll’s Charge reward.
Rune can save a useful number for a later round while Insurance protects Streak during risky rerolls. Using Rune to set a Boon face helps a recipe but gives no Favor or Streak.
Purify Face can erase Curse while keeping Boon on the same face, earning Grace for the cleanse. Fortune can then reroll that die for Boon without risking the removed Curse.
example: You have two Streak and one Insurance. A voluntary reroll misses every Boon, so Streak would fall to one. Spend Insurance to keep two instead. You gain no Favor from that miss. A later reroll hitting Boon can bring you to three Streak for Jackpot.
counter: Boon marks expire and disappear after two hits. A player must risk a real reroll to earn Streak; setting a marked face gives no Boon reward. Make Fortune spend Insurance defensively with Covered Loss to expose its next risky reroll.
balance: Favor gains from Boon are capped at two rewards per round, though a Boon’s two-hit lifetime still advances after that limit. Count Streak once per voluntary reroll, regardless of how many Boons appear. Insurance preserves one otherwise-lost Streak; it gives neither damage prevention nor Favor without a card saying so.
hooks: H-10 physical roll and command grouping
combos: Mark a face, then decide which dice to reroll. A Boon hit grows Streak. Insurance can preserve your progress when the attempt misses, without turning it into a successful roll.
The ability and card can supply Streak directly, using Favor and Energy. Jackpot spends three Streak for Energy and two drawn cards; it does not automatically happen when you reach three.

Favor.job: Trade earned luck for a small, reliable correction.
Favor.example: Use two Favor to change a 5 to a 6. This may finish your ability, but it does not earn Favor even if 6 has Boon.

Boon.job: Put a reward on a specific physical face.
Boon.example: Roll a face bearing both Boon and Curse: you gain Favor and also suffer that Curse’s normal effect.

Streak.job: Risk a good run for a larger payoff.
Streak.example: Reroll three dice and hit two Boons: gain one Streak. Your next reroll hits none, so you lose one Streak.

Insurance.job: Protect progress when you decide to risk another reroll.
Insurance.example: At two Streak, you reroll and miss. Spend Insurance to stay at two Streak and keep your chance of a later Jackpot.
